edit.description: Two halves of one enumeration, re-cited against the module 87fe7447 rewrote. (1) `discover` (:456) collects *files* per kind into `DiscoveryReport.members` (:428, a `BTreeMap<String, Vec<PathBuf>>`), so a `.claude/settings.json` carrying no hooks at all still reports `hook 1` — a file count printed by `render_discovery` (:475) under its "member counts by kind" heading; a registration kind's members are the entries at its `collection_address`, so the count comes from reading them. (2) `scaffold` (:1960) skips on `kind.content != kind::Content::File` under a comment naming only layout kinds, so every fields-shape kind — `hook`, `installed-plugin`, `known-marketplace`, `mcp-server` — is dropped silently and the container's first emit sheds its groups. Convert each discovered collection entry into a member module named by its registration key, so 0016's whole conversion covers a manifest's registration segments and not just the container member the sibling entry lifts. temper's own three gate hooks already reach the program as `hook` modules minted from `GATE_HOOKS` (:203) at the scaffold's own write loop, deliberately uncounted by the lift — this entry converts the project's own groups beside them, so the two writers must not collide on `.temper/hooks/<Event>.ts`. The whole change stays inside this module: `render_discovery`'s one call site (`src/main.rs:505`) binds the report and prints the rendered string, never destructuring it, so the ripple into `main.rs` is naming only.

The lift suite, now a module of the `it` crate (a7c8c9b5 folded `tests/install.rs` here; scaffolding is reached as `common::…` through `crate`). A project whose `.claude/settings.json` carries a `SessionStart` hook group and an `enabledPlugins` entry lifts one module per registration member, the first emit re-renders both segments beside the container's own keys, and the reported discovery count is the registration-entry count — pinned by a second fixture whose settings.json carries no registration segment at all and must report zero for those kinds. A third pin: a project whose own `SessionStart` group is not temper's gate command still lifts as its own module and does not overwrite the `GATE_HOOKS` module at that event.

summary: A registration member reaches no module: a settings.json hook group is counted in discovery and dropped by the lift, so the container's first emit sheds it.

tests.asserts: a settings.json carrying a hook group and an enabledPlugins entry lifts a module per registration member and the first emit re-renders both segments with the container's keys; a settings.json with no registration segment reports zero for those kinds

acceptance: `cargo test` green with `install` over a project whose settings.json carries registration segments producing a module per registration member, the adoption emit re-rendering the file with every segment intact, and the discovery report counting registration entries rather than the manifest file.
notes: Re-measured at e0d0123b: the count is a file count — a settings.json with no hooks, no enabledPlugins and no extraKnownMarketplaces still reports `hook 1`, `installed-plugin 1`, `known-marketplace 1`. Both halves survive 87fe7447's rewrite. Rests on `(hook-member-identity)`: a lifted hook needs a name, two groups on one event share one address. The tests/ fold has shipped and the path is re-cited; that blocker is discharged. scoped at 70afd6e0
